title: Human Fallopian Tube and Ovary Dissociation for Single Cell RNA-Seq
author: Melissa Javellana
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfudjns6
materials: Leaving on magnet, pipet off clear solution
Note: Keep all solutions at 37 °C throughout protocol.

steps.title: Prepare Pronase solution
steps.instruction: Make 10 mL of Pronase solution per sample in a 50 mL LoBind conical tube.

steps.title: Prepare digestion buffer
steps.instruction: Make 10 mL of digestion buffer per sample in a 50 mL LoBind conical tube.

steps.title: Rinse tissue
steps.instruction: Rinse gross blood off each sample with DMEM containing 10 % FBS.

steps.title: Pronase digestion
steps.instruction: Place each sample into 10 mL Pronase solution and incubate on a 37 °C orbital shaker at 200 rpm for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Separate epithelial fraction
steps.instruction: Using a 10 mL pipette, triturate the tissue to release the loose epithelial fraction, then pass the entire Pronase suspension through a 70 µm filter into a new 50 mL LoBind conical tube; rinse the filter with 10 mL DMEM/10 % FBS and collect the retained solid fraction.

substeps.instruction: Triturate tissue with a 10 mL pipette.
Filter pronase suspension through 70 µm filter into new tube.
Rinse filter with 10 mL DMEM/10 % FBS.
Recover solid fraction from original conical or from filter.

steps.title: Digest solid fraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the solid fraction to digestion buffer, then incubate on a 37 °C orbital shaker at 200 rpm for 30–45 minutes.

steps.title: Spin down epithelial cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the epithelial fraction at 400 rcf for 4 minutes, aspirate and discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 3 mL DMEM/FBS while the solid fraction completes digestion.

steps.title: Combine fractions
steps.instruction: Pass the digested solid‑fraction suspension through a 70 µm filter into the tube containing the epithelial fraction and rinse the filter with 10 mL DMEM/FBS.

substeps.instruction: Filter solid‑fraction suspension through 70 µm filter into epithelial‑fraction tube.

steps.title: Final spin and resuspend
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the combined suspension at 400 rcf for 4 minutes, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL PBS containing 0.05 % BSA.

steps.title: Add EDTA
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to an Eppendorf tube and add 12 µL of 0.5 M EDTA; mix gently.

steps.title: Resuspend RBC reagent
steps.instruction: Vortex the EasySep RBC depletion reagent bottle for 30 seconds to fully resuspend the contents.

steps.title: Add RBC depletion reagent
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of the EasySep RBC depletion reagent to the cell suspension and vortex gently for 3 seconds until the solution appears homogeneous.

steps.title: Magnetic incubation
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic separator and incubate for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Mince ovary tissue
steps.instruction: Using a scalpel, mince 100 mg of ovary tissue into 1–2 mm pieces.

steps.title: Assess cell viability
steps.instruction: Evaluate cell viability with trypan blue if proceeding immediately to single‑cell library preparation or any other downstream method.
